Hi Ethan/ Priya — Rishi here, engineering lead for integrations. Thanks for the questions — quick answers and next steps below:

- Customer-managed keys (BYOK): Supported for persistent model artifacts and snapshot backups in our Dedicated and Private deployments. For Hosted customers we offer a KMS integration option (AWS KMS / GCP KMS) where keys can be customer-controlled; rotation is supported with zero-downtime rewrap. I attached a short notes file summarizing config steps and endpoints: KMS_Integration_notes.txt.
- Key rotation: Rotation performed via rewrap — we support staged rewrap with rolling swap to ensure active requests are unaffected.
- Retention & logs: Audit logs retention is configurable by tenant; default is 90 days, configurable up to 7 years for Dedicated/Private. Request metadata can be scrubbed at the request layer before logs are persisted — we provide both field-level allowlists/denylists and a PII-scrubbing pipeline.

If useful I can do a 30-minute security/tech call to demonstrate the KMS workflow and show where retention policies are configured in the console. I have Thu 10:00–11:00 PT and Fri 08:00–10:00 PT open — which time works for you?

Regards,
Rishi Malhotra
